rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for telling two people or things apart.

example.english: Can you distinguish the taste of these two teas?
example.traditional: 你分得出呢兩種茶嘅味道嗎？
example.jyutping: nei5 fan1 dak1 ceot1 ni1 loeng5 zung2 caa4 ge3 mei6 dou6 maa3

rows.note: Use this when the issue is being able to see someone or something clearly.

example.english: Stand a little closer so I can distinguish your face clearly.
example.traditional: 你企近啲，我先睇清楚你個樣。
example.jyutping: nei5 kei5 gan6 di1 ngo5 sin1 tai2 cing1 co2 nei5 go3 joeng2

rows.note: Use this when someone achieves success and rises above their peers.

example.english: We have to work hard to distinguish ourselves from our peers.
example.traditional: 我哋要靠努力先可以出人頭地。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 kaau3 nou5 lik6 sin1 ho2 ji5 ceot1 jan4 tau4 dei6
